label: Burned area (monthly) — trend 2018→year (Sen's slope)
units: % of cell burned per year, per yr
scale: linear, symmetric about 0 (fixed across years: 98th percentile of |slope|)
source: MODIS MCD64A1 v061 via Microsoft Planetary Computer
basis: annual total (Jan-Dec) of the monthly MODIS MCD64A1 burned share of each 0.01° cell, in % (a cell burned in two months counts twice); re-derived from Planetary Computer. Months absent on Planetary Computer (2023-09, 2024-07, 2025-05, 2025-08..10; all outside the Nov-Apr fire season) are filled with the pixel's 2018-2025 mean for that calendar month. Missing months are filled by the climatology-anomaly method (yearly = mean monthly climatology + mean anomaly of the observed months); a year needs >= half of the season observed unless stated otherwise.
notes: Each image = per-pixel Theil-Sen (Sen's) slope of the yearly values from 2018 through the image year (>= 3 years), in % of cell burned per year, per yr. purple = decreasing, orange = increasing; white = no change. No significance test is applied per pixel: with 3-8 yearly points a slope is a description of change, not proof of a trend.
